jobs.title: Senior IT-Projektmanager / Technical Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Business Systems, Digitalisierung & KI

Du verstehst Softwareentwicklung, denkst in Geschäftsprozessen und bringst komplexe Projekte in die Umsetzung? Dann unterstütze mit uns wachsende Unternehmen dabei, ihre Systeme, Daten und Abläufe zukunftsfähig aufzustellen.

Du bist arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Fachabteilungen und technischen Verantwortlichen unserer Kunden zusammen. Unser Beratungs- und Engineering-Team unterstützt dich mit fachlichem Sparring und Entwicklungskompetenz.

Aufgaben
Du übernimmst die operative Verantwortung für Digitalisierungs- und Softwareprojekte – von der ersten Anforderungsaufnahme bis zur Einführung. Dabei verbindest du technische Tiefe mit wirtschaftlichem Denken und verlässlicher Projektsteuerung.

- Anforderungen klären: Du analysierst Prozesse, Systeme und Datenflüsse und führst die Bedürfnisse verschiedener Fachbereiche zusammen.
- Lösungen bewerten: Du vergleichst Standardsoftware, Integrationen und Eigenentwicklung hinsichtlich Nutzen, Kosten, Wartbarkeit und Skalierbarkeit.
- Umsetzung steuern: Du entwickelst priorisierte Roadmaps, definierst Arbeitspakete und koordinierst Beteiligte, Abhängigkeiten und Entscheidungen.
- Ergebnisse sichern: Du begleitest Einführung und Abnahme, dokumentierst Wissen und bereitest die Übergabe an interne Teams vor.
- KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du erkennst Potenziale für Automatisierung und berücksichtigst dabei Qualität, Datenschutz und Sicherheit.

Qualifikation

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in technischer Projektleitung, IT-Beratung oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit eigenständig verantworteten Software- oder Integrationsprojekten.
- Eigene Softwareentwicklungserfahrung und fundiertes Verständnis für Datenmodelle, APIs, Architektur und nachhaltigen Softwarebetrieb.
- Starke Analysefähigkeiten: Du übersetzt unklare Anforderungen in verständliche Prozesse, nachvollziehbare Entscheidungen und umsetzbare Schritte.
- Verständnis für Unternehmenssoftware, insbesondere für das Zusammenspiel von CRM, Backoffice, Kundenservice und Reporting.
- Wirtschaftliches Urteilsvermögen: Du priorisierst nach Nutzen, Aufwand und Risiken und kannst Eigenentwicklung gegen Zukauf abwägen.
- Selbstständigkeit und Verbindlichkeit: Du beschaffst fehlende Informationen, hältst offene Themen nach und schaffst Orientierung bei wechselnden Anforderungen.
- Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch mit Geschäftsführung, Fachbereichen und Entwicklern sowie Praxisverständnis für KI und Automatisierung.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte sind Erfahrungen mit wachsenden Unternehmen, CRM-/ERP-Einführungen, Unternehmensgruppen, KI-gestützter Entwicklung oder Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n, Make und Zapier.

Benefits
Du erhältst eigenständige Projektverantwortung, direkten Austausch mit Entscheidern und fachliche Unterstützung durch unser Team. Du gestaltest technische Lösungen mit und begleitest ihre Einführung in den Arbeitsalltag unserer Kunden.

Entscheidend sind für uns deine nachweisbaren Projektergebnisse und dein technisches Urteilsvermögen. Einen bestimmten Abschluss, eine Zertifizierung oder einen festen Technologie-Stack setzen wir nicht voraus.

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein bis zwei kurze Projektbeispiele: Welche Herausforderung hast du übernommen, welche Verantwortung hattest du und was wurde erreicht?

jobs.title: AI Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Das ist kein gewöhnlicher Job. Wir bauen paddy, das Agentic Operating System für Teaching & Learning, und arbeiten damit an einem der wichtigsten Themen für die Zukunftsfähigkeit unserer Gesellschaft: Bildung.

Unsere Mission ist es, Lehrkräfte zu entlasten, Lernergebnisse zu verbessern und die Unterrichtsqualität zu steigern.

Tausende Lehrkräfte und hunderttausende Lernende nutzen paddy bereits. Mit starken Investoren im Rücken wachsen wir schnell. Unsere Ambition ist es, den europäischen AI-Player für Bildung zu bauen.

Als AI Product Engineer übernimmst du Probleme unserer Nutzer End-to-End: vom Verständnis des Problems über Architektur, Backend und Frontend bis zum Deployment. Du prüfst, ob die Lösung im Klassenzimmer wirklich funktioniert. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf AI Engineering: Du baust die agentischen Systeme, die paddy ausmachen, und bringst sie zuverlässig, schnell und bezahlbar in Production.

Aufgaben

- Product Engineering Erfahrung: Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb moderner Webanwendungen mit TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js und React, in einem Produktteam mit echten Nutzer.
- AI Engineering Know-how: Du hast LLM-basierte Features oder agentische Systeme gebaut und in Production betrieben. Du verstehst Context Windows, Failure Modes von Modellen, RAG, Vektor-Datenbanken und warum Prompts ohne Evals nicht fertig sind. Kein ML Research nötig, aber echtes technisches Verständnis statt Feature-Ebene.
- Technisches Fundament: Du bist sicher in API-Design, Datenbanken (SQL, NoSQL und Vector), Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) und CI/CD. Dein stärkster Schwerpunkt darf Backend und Architektur sein, aber du bist kein enger Spezialist.
- Ownership und Urteilskraft: Du kommst mit unterspezifizierten Problemen klar, findest einfache Lösungen für komplexe Fragen und baust Systeme, die auch im Schulalltag funktionieren.
- AI-native Arbeitsweise: Du nutzt Coding Agents und moderne AI-Tools selbstverständlich, um deinen Output zu vervielfachen, und beschäftigst dich intensiv damit, wie AI Softwareentwicklung verändert.
- Sprachen: Fließend Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch.

Qualifikation

- Sichtbaren Impact: Du arbeitest am wichtigsten Zukunftsthema unserer Gesellschaft, der Bildung.
- 70.000 bis 100.000 € Bruttojahresgehalt, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung, plus Equity (VSOP).
- 100 % Remote-Arbeit. Wenn du lieber ins Büro kommst, steht dir unser modernes Office in Bielefeld offen.
- Großen Gestaltungsspielraum und Ownership sowie direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Foundern und einem starken Product- und Engineering-Team.
- Ein hohes Budget, solange der Nutzen stimmt.
- Zeit und Unterstützung für deine Entwicklung, mit Fortbildungsbudget, Coaching und klaren Entwicklungsperspektiven.
- 30 Urlaubstage und 50 € monatlichen steuerfreien Sachbezug.
- Regelmäßige Team-Events und Offsites.
- Starkes Backing durch erfahrene Investoren und Mentoren.

Benefits

- Brutaler Impact: Du arbeitest an dem wichtigsten gesellschaftlichen Thema überhaupt: Bildung.
- 70.000 bis 100.000 € Brutto-Jahresgehalt, abhängig von Erfahrung, plus Equity (VSOP)
- 100 % Remote: Wenn du lieber vor Ort arbeitest, steht dir unser modernes Office in Bielefeld offen
- Nahezu unbegrenztes Budget, solange der ROI stimmt
- Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Foundern und einem starken Product-&-Engineering-Team
- Sehr viel Gestaltungsspielraum & full Ownership
- Weiterentwicklung & Lernen: Budget für Fortbildungen, Zugang zu Coaching und klare Entwicklungsperspektiven
- 30 Urlaubstage, 50 € monatlicher steuerfreier Sachbezug
- Regelmäßige Team-Events und Offsites
- Starkes Backing: Top-Investoren und Mentoren

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

Wenn die Kalender passen, können wir den gesamten Prozess innerhalb von fünf Tagen abschließen.

- Kennenlernen, Tag 1: Im ersten Gespräch schauen wir, ob es für beide Seiten passt. Wenn ja, vereinbaren wir direkt deinen Probetag.
- Probetag mit Case Study, Tag 4: Du arbeitest mit uns an einer echten Aufgabe und stellst anschließend dein Ergebnis vor.
- Gespräch mit unserem CEO, Tag 4: Das Gespräch findet am Abend deines Probetags statt.
- Teamgespräch, Tag 5: Du lernst die Engineers kennen, mit denen du arbeiten wirst.
- Entscheidung, Tag 5: Nach dem Teamgespräch geben wir dir unsere finale Rückmeldung.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Erzähl uns, welche Probleme du gelöst, welche Entscheidungen du getroffen und welche Systeme du in Produktion gebracht hast.

jobs.description:
About the Job:
The Corporate Account Executive is a hunter-focused role responsible for driving net new business and expanding existing accounts within the mid-market segment. This role requires strong outbound prospecting instincts, the ability to self-generate pipeline, and a proven track record of quota attainment in a SaaS environment. LaunchDarkly is looking for product-oriented, customer-focused, sales-driven individuals to help expand our Corporate AE team. You'll work directly with a manager, sales engineers, and other resources to help customers successfully test, purchase, and adopt LaunchDarkly.

Responsibilities:

- Self-generate pipeline through consistent outbound prospecting into ICP target accounts (this is a core skill for the role, not a supporting one).
- Articulate and sell the value of LaunchDarkly’s' platform subscriptions
- Prepare for and run discovery sessions with new prospects to surface LaunchDarkly's core use cases and the value of the usage-based pricing model
- Customize and deliver demos with the Solutions Engineering team
- Run proofs of concept for prospects
- Own, build, and grow relationships with existing customers — driving product adoption and uncovering new expansion opportunities
- Consistently hit revenue targets and accurately forecast on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis

LaunchDarkly is looking for a Backend Engineer to help build and expand Vega, our AI-powered platform that surfaces insights and automates actions across LaunchDarkly products. This is a greenfield opportunity: you'll help evolve Vega from an Observability-focused assistant into a cross-product platform that serves Feature Management customers and powers a new, usage-based SKU.

You'll build the APIs, services, and agent infrastructure that make Vega and the whole Observability platform broadly valuable—enabling capabilities like AI-driven dashboard creation, flag cleanup automation, and safe, sandboxed agent execution. You'll work primarily in Go services and data pipelines at significant scale, and collaborate closely with product, design, and other engineering teams to shape how AI capabilities land across LaunchDarkly. Additionally, you'll work on other Enterprise-grade capabilities for the Observability platform to help drive customer activation and success.

- Design, build, and ship backend features across the Vega platform (APIs, Go services, agent infrastructure, and data pipelines)
- Own features end-to-end: from prototype and API design through production rollout and iteration
- Operate high-throughput data systems and keep them reliable, performant, and cost-efficient at scale

jobs.title: Data Analyst - SQL / Databricks
jobs.description:
Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc

Your Role:

As a Data Analyst in our Business Intelligence organization, you will turn operational and customer data into actionable reports and dashboards that drive business decisions. You will partner directly with internal business teams, such as sales compensation, to gather reporting requirements, document technical specifications, and build user friendly data assets.

Your primary hands-on work will involve writing SQL views and building dashboards directly within Databricks using data populated by our engineering team. A key aspect of this role is context engineering, where you will add structured descriptions and metadata to tables, views, and columns so that our data is easily discoverable and accurately queried by AI tools like Claude. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.


We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.


We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.


This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.


The Role
As a Senior Product Designer at RevenueCat, you’ll own complex product problems from discovery through production. You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering to understand customers, identify opportunities, shape what we build and why, and turn technically complex workflows into simple, polished experiences for developers.


You’ll join a small design team with a high bar for interaction and visual craft. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, talks directly to customers, prototypes and iterates quickly, and stays involved until the work is shipped and working well in production.


About you

- 
You have a strong track record solving complex product problems in B2B, SaaS, developer tools, or similarly complex environments.



- 
You can frame ambiguous problems, identify opportunities, make sound trade-offs, and help shape what gets built and why.



- 
You design clear, intuitive workflows and think carefully about information architecture, states, edge cases, errors, and interactions.



- 
You have a high visual craft bar and care deeply about hierarchy, typography, spacing, composition, and polish.



- 
You stay close to customers, using direct conversations and qualitative and quantitative evidence to inform your decisions.



- 
You work closely with Product and Engineering, involve partners early, reduce scope intelligently, and stay engaged through implementation and follow-up.



- 
You communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous environment and take ownership beyond the boundaries of a design handoff.



- 
You understand technical constraints well enough to make realistic decisions and are comfortable using prototypes, code, or modern AI tools when they help you learn or move faster.



- 
You are excited about our mission to help developers make more money.




In the first month, you'll

- 
Get to know our product, customers, and teams.



- 
Familiarize yourself with our design system and visual language.



- 
Talk to some customers to understand their needs.



- 
Start engaging in discovery and design for your first meaningful project.




Within the first 3 months, you'll

- 
Have taken full ownership of all design aspects for your cross-functional product team.



- 
Have seen the first project shipped that you worked on from ideation to launch.



- 
Work with your team to discover opportunities and solutions to deliver value to our customers.




Within the first 6 months, you'll

- 
Be an integral product partner within your cross-functional team, helping shape priorities and product direction.



- 
Raise the bar for interaction and visual craft within your area while contributing patterns and improvements that benefit the broader product.



- 
Contribute to the development of the design practice at RevenueCat through critique, shared patterns, and collaboration with the rest of the design team.




Within the first 12 months, you'll

- 
Have shipped meaningful product improvements end to end, from identifying the opportunity through implementation and iteration.



- 
Help improve reusable patterns, systems, and ways of working that make the design team more effective without adding unnecessary process.



- 
Be a strong advocate for customer understanding, product quality, and thoughtful design across RevenueCat.




What we offer:

- 
Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator



- 
10-year window to exercise vested equity options



- 
A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility



- 
4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually



- 
Paid desk at a co-working space



- 
Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend




Interviewing at RevenueCat
Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat, including tips to help you succeed.


More on how we work:

- 
How we think about hiring and team design: Building a Winning Team



- 
The values that guide how we work: Our Values



- 
How we work as a remote team: How We Work Remotely at RevenueCat



- 
What to expect from our interview process: Interview Expectations



- 
What to expect from comp and employment: Employment FAQ

jobs.title: Atlassian Platform Architect
jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

What We’re Looking For

As Datavant scales, Jira and the broader Atlassian ecosystem increasingly underpin how teams coordinate work, manage services, connect systems, and provide visibility across the organization. As our Atlassian Platform Architect, you will own the technical direction, architecture, health, and evolution of Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and the broader Atlassian ecosystem.

This is a senior, hands-on role combining enterprise architecture with deep technical delivery. You will define the target architecture, roadmap, governance, data and integration standards, while personally designing and implementing complex automations, integrations, workflows, reporting, and service management solutions.

You will lead platform remediation and transformation, reduce technical debt, and ensure the environment remains secure, resilient, scalable, and maintainable. You will also serve as the senior technical partner to our Jira administration team, setting the standards they work to and taking ownership of changes requiring deeper architecture or engineering expertise.

What You Will Do

- Define and maintain the target architecture, technical strategy and prioritized roadmap for Jira, JSM, Confluence and the wider Atlassian ecosystem.
- Establish enterprise standards for data models, workflows, schemes, fields, permissions, automation, integrations, reporting and naming conventions.
- Take ownership of platform health and lead the remediation of configuration sprawl, technical debt, duplicate objects and inconsistent platform patterns.
- Design and implement complex solutions using Jira Automation, Rovo, ScriptRunner, REST APIs, webhooks and Marketplace applications.
- Define JSM and ITSM architecture supporting service requests, incidents, problems, changes, knowledge and asset management.
- Establish integration standards covering APIs, identity systems, authentication, data ownership, monitoring, error handling and recovery.
- Define security, privacy, availability, recoverability, performance, data-retention and audit requirements.
- Introduce architecture reviews, change controls and lifecycle-management processes that protect the platform while supporting delivery.
- Lead major platform remediation, consolidation, migration, redesign and integration initiatives.
- Evaluate Marketplace applications and emerging Atlassian capabilities, including Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo, based on security, privacy, cost and maintainability.
- Partner with IT, Security, Privacy, Compliance, Enterprise Systems, Product and Engineering to translate requirements into sustainable technical solutions.
- Provide technical leadership to Jira administrators by reviewing complex changes, establishing reusable patterns, mentoring the team and taking ownership of high-risk work.
- Act as the senior escalation point for architectural issues, significant platform risks and complex technical decisions.
- Support licensing, application rationalization, vendor decisions and platform investment planning.

What You Need to Succeed

- 6-8 years experience leading Jira and the Atlassian ecosystem within a large or complex organisation.
- Deep hands-on Jira Cloud and JSM expertise across workflows, schemes, custom fields, permissions, automation, security and project configuration.
- Strong technical experience with Forge, REST APIs, webhooks, workflow extensions and enterprise integrations.
- Experience defining enterprise architecture, platform governance, configuration standards, technical roadmaps and reusable design patterns.
- Experience designing JSM and ITSM solutions aligned with ITIL practices and an enterprise IT operating model.
- Strong knowledge of Atlassian Cloud identity and security, including Atlassian Guard, SAML, SSO, SCIM, provisioning and access controls.
- Direct experience working with both HIPAA and FedRAMP requirements and translating them into practical platform controls.
- Experience assessing platform health and leading remediation, migration, consolidation or transformation initiatives.
- Experience evaluating and governing Marketplace applications and other Atlassian extensions.
- Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to move confidently between strategy, technical design, hands-on delivery and team mentoring.
- A willingness to take ownership of a challenging environment, make clear technical decisions and drive issues through to resolution.

jobs.description:

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Your Role:

The Associate Services Architect is a content-focused role responsible for creating, updating, and maintaining technical content for the Professional Services Portfolio. This role blends technical aptitude with content development and communication skills, working under the mentorship of a Senior Services Architect or Manager to design, draft, and update consulting service offerings, training content, and enablement material.

This position is specifically scoped around portfolio maintenance: keeping existing courses, labs, and collateral current as products evolve, and absorbing update-tier and Tier-1 support work so that Senior Services Architects can focus their time on strategic development and net-new offerings. The role receives structured intake and mentoring support from their manager and works closely with the broader Services Architecture team.

Your Opportunity:

Content Creation & Maintenance:

- Content Updates: Design, draft, and update consulting service offerings, enablement content, educational material, and technical presentations for webinars and events.
- Maintenance Backlog: Own update-tier fixes and content refreshes for existing courses and labs, keeping material current as Tenable products evolve.
- Collateral Support: Create collateral for new offerings and evaluate existing offerings and content for accuracy and relevance.
- Services Offerings: Help create and support the development of consulting services offerings.

Delivery & Review:

- Pre-Production Training: Deliver pre-production training sessions to evaluate product suitability and gather early feedback.
- Live Demonstrations: Create live demonstration recordings for the Tenable product suite.
- Content Review: Perform content reviews with peers in Services, Technical Support, Customer Success, and Product Management to ensure quality and alignment with customer needs.
- Quality Assurance: Review and validate updated course materials and lab environments to ensure technical accuracy and consistency before release.
- Service Offerings Review: Participate in the review and validation of new consulting service offerings to ensure alignment with portfolio standards and technical feasibility.

Strategic Engagement & Support:

- Customer & Partner Engagement: Engage with customers and partners to analyze market trends and the competitive landscape.
- Cross-Functional Problem Solving: Work closely with all departments to identify and resolve problems, gathering information to support data-driven decisions.
- Tier-1 Support Coverage: Provide first-line responses to Customer Care escalations on assigned courses, triaging and resolving routine issues before they require senior architect time.
- Staying Current: Remain abreast of corporate direction and strategy, product roadmaps, messaging, and emerging trends in the security industry.

Project & Process Management:

- Independent Delivery: Independently manage assigned projects on schedule, escalating risks and dependencies early.
- Process Improvement: Remain abreast of educational frameworks, content development approaches, and technologies that may reduce costs or shorten development timelines.
- Other Duties: May perform other duties and responsibilities that management may deem necessary from time to time.

What You’ll Need:

- Security Foundations: 1–3 years of overall experience in Information Security, or equivalent training/education/services.
- Vulnerability Management Exposure: Some exposure to vulnerability management concepts; prior experience with the Tenable product suite is a plus.
- Content or Training Background: Experience in technical writing, instructional design, or training delivery is beneficial but not required.
- Services Experience: Prior experience in professional services or consulting environments is highly valued.
- Education: B.S. degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
- Technical Foundations: Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking; foundational understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems.
- Security Tools Familiarity: Familiarity with security assessment tools such as Nessus, Kali Linux, or Metasploit is a plus.
- Emerging Domains: Exposure to web application security, container security, or cloud environments (AWS/Azure) is a plus but not required at this level.
- Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
- Autonomy with Support: Able to work remotely as part of a geographically distributed team, with structured mentoring and support from their manager.
- Ability to work remotely in a self-directed manner
- Physically able to participate in training sessions, presentations and meetings
- Some Tenable office travel may be required

jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

What We’re Looking For:

As a Clinical Documentation Quality Improvement (CDQI) Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in elevating the impact of our medical record documentation. You will conduct daily evaluations and engage in direct communication with providers to enhance documentation clarity, completeness, and overall medical record quality. By ensuring accurate and comprehensive physician documentation, you will be at the forefront of influencing the precision of code assignment, making a tangible difference in the accuracy of healthcare data. Join us in this critical role where your efforts will have a direct and meaningful impact on the quality and effectiveness of patient care.

What You Will Do:

- Conduct timely, accurate, and complete documentation reviews for selected inpatient records, addressing inadequate or conflicting documentation.
- Collaborate with physicians and caregivers to ensure appropriate reimbursement and clinical severity for DRG-based payer patients.
- Demonstrate understanding of complications, co-morbidities, severity of illness, risk of mortality, case mix index, secondary diagnoses, and procedure impact on DRG.
- Improve coding specificity by educating physicians and caregivers on the importance of clear documentation throughout a patient's stay.
- Follow AHA guidelines and coding clinics for accurate coding and required documentation to ensure compliance.
- Query physicians regarding missing, unclear, or conflicting health record documentation to obtain necessary details.
- Maintain daily production logs for evaluation, tracking cases reviewed, queries placed/responded, etc.
- Perform follow-up reviews to confirm recorded points of clarification in the patient's medical record.
- Ensure confidentiality of all files, documents, and records.
- Meet or exceed production and quality metrics.

What You Need to Succeed:

- 3+ years of CDI experience
- 3+ years of clinical experience in an academic medical center
- Registered Nurse license, Bachelor's degree in Nursing
- CCDS or CDIP certification required
- Must pass a CDI skills competency assessment

jobs.title: Director Of RevOps (SMSO046)
jobs.description:
Role Description
Defense Unicorns gets mission-critical software to the warfighter faster and more securely. Revenue Operations is what keeps the go-to-market team moving at that speed without losing track of the details.

As Director of Revenue Operations, you own the systems, data, and processes our sales, solutions architecture, and customer success teams rely on every day. This is a hands-on role, not a reporting desk. You will sit close to revenue leadership and the deals themselves, from first pipeline through close, renewal, and expansion, and you will bring order to a fast-growing environment without getting in its way.

Responsibilities
CRM and Revenue Systems

- Own HubSpot as primary administrator: data integrity, pipeline hygiene, and adoption across the go-to-market team.
- Maintain the deal pipelines (Direct Opportunities, Competitive Solicitations, Renewals) with consistent stages, required fields, and automation.
- Manage integrations between HubSpot and the tools around it (Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and others).
- Keep deal data clean and usable: naming conventions, MEDDPICC qualification fields (Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Identify Pain, Champion, Competition), D&F dates, DRB data, product feature tags, and ARR calculations.

Pipeline Analytics and Forecasting

- Run the quarterly forecast process between sellers and revenue leadership, and surface where coverage is thin and where the upside is.
- Maintain forecast models built on pipeline stage, PWIN, deal velocity, and past conversion rates.
- Give leadership the analytics they need at the deal and portfolio level: coverage ratios, pipeline aging, and win/loss patterns.
- Flag pipeline and deal risk early, before it shows up in the number.

Go-to-Market Process

- Work with sales and solutions architecture leadership to document and sharpen the sales process, from qualified opportunity through Focused Discovery, Deal Review Board (DRB), scoping, proposal, and close.
- Set up lead routing, territory and account assignment, and clean handoffs between sales and marketing.
- Run the cadence for pipeline reviews, QBRs, and annual planning.
- Support competitive solicitations: opportunity tracking, bid/no-bid analysis, and capture management.

Quoting, Pricing, and Revenue Tracking

- Run deal desk operations covering pricing, discounting, contract structure, and approvals.
- Maintain SKU-level pricing across UDS Premium, Application Licenses, Edge Node Licenses, Software Factory, SRE Operations, PaaS, and training and services.
- Work with Finance on bookings recognition, ARR tracking, and revenue reporting.

Enablement and Adoption

- Improve CRM adoption and data quality through training, clear documentation, and follow-through.
- Build the playbooks, templates, and automation that take busywork off sellers and solution architects.

About Ramp

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

jobs.title: Director of Discovery & Framing
jobs.description:
Role Mission
Own, lead, and scale Discovery & Framing at Defense Unicorns—help customers identify and clearly define the mission problems that matter, quantify their impact, establish what success looks like, and create the clarity needed to determine the right path forward.

The Head of Discovery & Framing will lead the highest-priority customer engagements, establish the D&F methodology and quality standard, and build the team required to deliver the discipline at scale.

The Role
Defense Unicorns is creating a dedicated Discovery & Framing function to improve how we understand customer problems before moving into solution design.

This is a senior, hands-on strategy role for someone who knows how to walk into an ambiguous customer situation, ask the questions others miss, separate symptoms from root causes, and turn a complex discussion into a clear and measurable mission problem.

Trust is built by knowing the customer's mission intimately—its language, operating tempo, constraints, failure modes, stakeholder pressures, and consequences of getting it wrong.

The Head of D&F must be equally comfortable facilitating a working session with senior customer leaders, interviewing operators and technical stakeholders, analyzing what was learned, and producing a concise executive-quality output afterward.

This is not a traditional sales role, product presentation role, or technical discovery role.

Operating principle: Help the customer define and measure the right problem before asking them to choose a solution.

What You Will Own
Lead Discovery & Framing Engagements
Prepare for and personally facilitate high-value D&F engagements with customer executives, mission leaders, operators, technical stakeholders, acquisition leaders, and other key participants.

Lead the most strategic, complex, or ambiguous engagements while developing additional D&F practitioners to handle increasing volume.

Build the Discovery & Framing Function
Establish the D&F methodology, engagement model, playbook, question bank, templates, quality standards, and examples of what great looks like.

Determine capacity requirements and build the D&F team as demand grows.

Coach and develop D&F practitioners while remaining personally involved in important customer engagements.

Start With a Hypothesis
Work with the account team before each engagement to establish:

- What we believe we know
- What remains an assumption
- What we need to learn
- Who must participate
- What decision or next step the engagement needs to advance

The hypothesis provides structure without predetermining the answer.

Discover the Real Problem
Move the customer conversation beyond the initial technical request to understand:

- The mission being performed
- Current state
- What is not working today
- Root causes
- Existing workarounds
- Constraints
- Who is affected
- Why the problem matters
- Why it matters now
- What happens if nothing changes

Continue asking why until the team understands the underlying mission problem rather than simply the requested technology.

Frame the Problem
Turn discovery into a clear problem definition the customer recognizes as their own.

Define:

- The mission problem
- Who experiences it
- Root causes
- Measurable impact
- Current workarounds
- Desired future state
- Consequences of inaction
- The gap between current and desired states

The problem should be expressed in the customer's language—not Defense Unicorns product language.

Make the Impact Measurable
Quantify the problem wherever possible using measures such as:

- Mission readiness
- Time
- Cost
- Operational risk
- Availability
- Deployment speed
- Reliability
- Workforce capacity
- Manual effort
- Delays
- Failure rates
- Mission outcomes

Establish a baseline so the customer can determine whether the problem has actually been solved.

Define Success
Help the customer establish the outcomes and success criteria that indicate meaningful improvement.

Answer two questions:

What must change?

How will we know it changed?

Map the Decision System
Identify the people and organizations involved in moving the problem toward action, including:

- Mission Influencer
- Mission Hero
- Buyer
- Requirements owner
- Funding owner
- Acquiring organization
- Technical stakeholders
- People who can advance the decision
- People who can block the decision

Understand the relationships, incentives, concerns, and gaps among them.

Expose the Path to Action
Determine what must happen for the customer to act, including:

- Decision criteria
- Decision process
- Funding source
- Acquisition path
- Contracting path
- Competitive alternatives
- Status quo
- Organizational barriers
- Evidence still required
- Events creating urgency
- Timing constraints

Own the Customer-Facing Output
Every D&F engagement should result in a concise, customer-ready readout.

The Head of D&F owns the quality of these outputs across the function.

Each output should include:

- Validated mission problem
- Current state and root causes
- Quantified impact
- Current workarounds
- Consequences of inaction
- Desired future state
- Success criteria
- Stakeholder and buying map
- Decision criteria and process
- Funding and acquisition path
- Remaining evidence gaps
- Owners and dates
- Agreed mutual next step

The output should be useful enough that the customer and account team can act on it immediately.

Maintain Independence of Judgment
Discovery & Framing is not a disguised product pitch.

The D&F function objectively determines whether a meaningful problem exists, whether solving it matters, and whether Defense Unicorns has a credible role in helping address it.

A successful D&F engagement may:

- Advance an opportunity
- Redirect an opportunity
- Identify additional discovery required
- Reveal that another problem should take priority
- Disqualify an opportunity

The D&F Engagement
A strong D&F engagement follows five stages:

1. Prepare
Research the account, mission, technical environment, stakeholders, and opportunity context. Align with the account team on hypotheses, unknowns, participants, and objectives.

2. Discover
Facilitate a customer-first conversation to understand the current state, mission, root problem, constraints, workarounds, stakeholders, and impact. Ask questions until evidence replaces assumptions.

3. Frame
Turn what was discovered into a clear, measurable problem statement. Connect the problem to mission impact, desired outcomes, and consequences of inaction.

4. Validate
Validate the problem framing with the customer. Test the problem, impact, urgency, baseline, desired outcomes, success criteria, stakeholder roles, decision criteria, and remaining assumptions.

5. Mobilize
Deliver the customer readout and establish a dated mutual next step. Connect the problem to a Defense Unicorns capability only where there is a legitimate fit.

How You Will Work
Account Executive / Mission Seller: Owns the customer relationship, account and opportunity strategy, commercial process, and follow-through on agreed actions.

Head of Discovery & Framing: Owns the D&F methodology, engagement preparation, facilitation, synthesis, customer-facing outputs, quality standards, team development, and capacity.

Discovery & Framing Strategist: Supports and leads D&F engagements under the methodology and standards established by the Head of D&F. Conducts research, facilitates assigned engagements, analyzes findings, produces customer outputs, and maintains internal records.

Solutions Engineer / Technical Lead: Owns technical discovery, architecture, feasibility, solution design, and technical validation once the mission problem and desired outcomes are sufficiently understood.

Sales Leadership and Enablement: Reinforce adoption, qualification discipline, coaching, and follow-through.

What You Bring
Client-Facing Strategy Depth
8+ years of experience in strategy consulting, management consulting, customer strategy, value advisory, or another highly structured client-facing problem-solving environment.

Meaningful experience at firms such as McKinsey & Company, Bain & Company, Boston Consulting Group, Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG, or a comparable strategy or advisory organization is highly valued.

Executive Facilitation
A strong record of personally leading executive interviews, workshops, diagnostic engagements, and cross-functional working sessions.

Able to ask difficult questions respectfully, challenge assumptions, manage competing perspectives, and help senior stakeholders arrive at clarity.

Structured Problem Solving
Exceptional ability in:

- Hypothesis-led discovery
- Issue structuring
- Root-cause analysis
- Five Whys
- Stakeholder mapping
- Impact quantification
- Business and mission analysis
- Synthesis
- Executive communication

Mission Intimacy and Translation
Ability to rapidly learn and operate within the customer's mission context.

Trust requires more than knowing the technology. You learn the mission language, operating environment, organizational pressures, constraints, failure modes, and consequences of failure.

You can translate across mission, operational, acquisition, business, and technical perspectives.

Crisp Executive Communication
Outstanding written and verbal communication with the ability to turn hours of complex customer discussion into a short, clear, defensible executive readout.

Team-Building Leadership
Experience building, scaling, or leading a consulting, strategy, advisory, professional services, or customer-facing team.

You know how to establish a methodology, develop people, maintain quality, and determine when additional capacity is needed.

Especially Valuable

- Experience working with complex, mission-driven organizations
- Experience operating in regulated or highly secure environments
- Acquisition and contracting fluency
- Familiarity with enterprise software, DevSecOps, cloud, cybersecurity, platform engineering, software delivery, or mission systems
- Experience connecting operational requirements to funding and acquisition
- Familiarity with MEDDPICC or another rigorous enterprise qualification methodology

How Success Will Be Measured
Better discovery: Customers validate that D&F accurately reflects their mission problem rather than simply restating a technical request.

Measurable problems: A growing percentage of engagements establish quantified impact, baselines, desired outcomes, and success criteria.

Better qualification: Opportunities progress with fewer unknowns around mission value, stakeholders, decision process, funding, acquisition, and urgency.

Strong customer outputs: Post-session readouts are timely, concise, customer-validated, and useful enough for customers and account teams to act on immediately.

Opportunity movement: D&F engagements result in a clear decision to advance, redirect, investigate further, or disqualify.

Fewer late surprises: Reduce late-stage problems caused by unclear customer pain, weak mission value, missing stakeholders, uncertain funding, undefined decision processes, or unsupported assumptions.

A scalable D&F capability: Build a team of D&F practitioners capable of delivering consistent customer engagements under a common methodology and quality standard.

What This Role Is

- Functional leader of Discovery & Framing
- Senior customer strategist
- Executive facilitator
- Structured problem solver
- Builder of the D&F methodology
- Builder and leader of the D&F team
- Independent tester of customer problem and fit
- Bridge between mission problem and capability need

What This Role Is Not

- A quota-carrying Account Executive
- A general sales enablement role
- A product marketer
- A Solutions Engineer
- A technical architecture role
- A one-time workshop facilitator
- A presentation resource
- A disguised product pitch

Operating Principle
Understand the mission. Discover the real problem. Frame it in measurable terms. Validate it with the customer. Then determine what should happen next.

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States.

Remote - USA

$204,000—$276,000 USD

Who We Are
Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role
Ramp is seeking an experienced Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) for Billhop AB, our Swedish-regulated Payment Institution. Under Swedish law, this role is legally defined as Centralt funktionsansvarig (CF) — the independent function holder responsible for day-to-day AML oversight and for reporting suspicious activity directly to Finanspolisen (the Swedish Financial Intelligence Unit). This is a standalone, high-accountability compliance leadership role: you will own Billhop AB's AML/CTF program and Compliance oversight, act as the primary point of contact for Finansinspektionen (FI), and serve as the gatekeeper protecting Ramp's Swedish entity from financial crime.

-
Act as primary regulatory contact with Finansinspektionen, managing supervisory correspondence, periodic reporting, and support licensing efforts

-
Manage the entity's internal reporting channels for potential AML/CTF infractions

-
Maintain and evolve the AML/CTF risk assessment, policies, and procedures, including NPAP review for new products

-
Prepare and present the MLRO report to the Billhop AB board and leadership

-
Partner with Ramp's broader Compliance, Legal, and Engineering teams (US/UK) on cross-border projects

What You Need

-
8+ years of financial services experience in compliance, AML, or related regulatory advisory roles, preferably in fintech

AI Fluency and demonstrated experience leveraging AI to build and scale AML programs

jobs.title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses.

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.

Who We Are
We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

This role develops and scales large-scale machine learning training systems for multimodal robotics data, enabling the creation of high-performance autonomy models. By optimizing distributed training pipelines, neural network architectures, and data processing workflows, the position improves training efficiency, accelerates model iteration, and maximizes GPU utilization. The role collaborates closely with ML researchers and infrastructure teams, influencing the design, deployment, and performance of end-to-end autonomy models and the large-scale data pipelines that support them.

Responsibilities

-
Design and maintain training systems that can process and learn from petabyte-scale multimodal datasets (e.g., video and point cloud data). This includes ensuring data is efficiently loaded, distributed, and processed across large GPU clusters.

-
Identify and resolve bottlenecks in the training pipeline, including data loading, preprocessing, model computation, and inter-node communication, to maximize GPU utilization and reduce training time.

-
Work with the ML team to develop and refine neural network architectures suitable for autonomy tasks, particularly those handling high-dimensional and sequential sensor data.

-
Create and adjust loss functions and training strategies that help the model learn effectively from complex multimodal inputs and improve autonomy performance.

-
Configure, monitor, and maintain large-scale distributed training jobs across multiple machines and GPUs, ensuring stability, fault tolerance, and efficient resource usage.

-
Implement scalable systems to preprocess, transform, and augment large robotics datasets so that they are suitable for model training.

-
Work closely with ML scientists and other engineers to integrate new models, experiments, and training approaches into the production training pipeline.

-
Analyze training metrics, model outputs, and experiment logs to assess model performance and guide improvements in architecture, data usage, or training strategies.

-
Develop tools and workflows that allow teams to run experiments, track results, and iterate quickly on new model ideas or training approaches.

Qualifications

-
Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a closely related technical discipline.

-
Minimum of 5 years of professional experience developing, training, and deploying machine learning models in production environments.

-
Hands-on experience training machine learning models across multiple GPUs or compute nodes, including familiarity with distributed training frameworks and large dataset handling.

-
Strong programming skills in Python for implementing machine learning models, data pipelines, and training workflows.

-
Solid knowledge of core concepts such as neural networks, optimization algorithms, loss functions, model evaluation, and training methodologies.

What Makes You Stand out

-
Experience identifying and resolving training bottlenecks related to compute utilization, memory usage, and data throughput in machine learning systems.

-
Experience training machine learning models on robotics or autonomous driving datasets involving multimodal sensor inputs such as camera video, LiDAR point clouds, radar, or telemetry data.

-
Experience developing models that combine multiple data modalities (e.g., images, point clouds, and structured sensor data) into a unified learning system.

-
Peer-reviewed publications or significant research contributions in machine learning, robotics, or related areas.

*Please note: The listed base salary range applies to candidates based in the US. Compensation may vary depending on location, experience, and role alignment. We are open to qualified candidates working remotely in Canada

-
Canada - ALL: $177k - $215k CAD

Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Attributes

About Quora:
Quora’s mission is to grow the world's collective intelligence. To do so, we have two platforms:

-
Quora: a global knowledge sharing platform with millions of monthly unique visitors, bringing people together to share insights on various topics and providing a unique platform to learn and connect with others.

-
Poe: a cloud workspace where millions of users run multiple AI agents on shared context and tools. One subscription, every frontier model, and the collaboration layer that makes them work together.

Behind these products are passionate, collaborative, and high-performing global teams. We have a culture rooted in transparency, idea-sharing, and experimentation that allows us to celebrate success and grow together through meaningful work. Join us on this journey to create a positive impact and make a significant change in the world.

This role will be working on our Quora product.

About the Team and Role:
Our Monetization team works on challenging problems every day. Our Machine Learning Engineers are tasked with optimizing the advertising product at Quora, and the team covers the entire Machine Learning Ads lifecycle from end-to-end, including ads targeting, ranking and auction dynamics, and quality measurement. Ingrained in our culture is the desire to constantly learn and improve, and our engineers are encouraged to think big and experiment with new ideas. Using continuous deployment, we quickly see our changes in the product and make fast iterations. As a remote-first company, our engineers have a high degree of flexibility and autonomy, and everyone on the engineering team has a huge impact on our product, revenue and company.

Since we first launched our advertising platform, we've grown to support thousands of advertisers who are reaching over 300 million+ monthly unique visitors on Quora. Our journey is just beginning as we continue to build new products from the ground up and tackle exciting challenges at scale. We are looking for an experienced Machine Learning Engineer to join the Ads ML team as an ads ranking specialist. You will improve CTR and CVR prediction, model calibration, user and ad representations, and user-sequence modeling, translating improvements in ranking quality into measurable advertiser value, revenue, and better user experiences. This is a small, close-knit team where you own problems end-to-end — research, data, modeling, deployment and maintenance — and where your work has a direct line to the company's top line.

Responsibilities:

-
Develop and improve ads ranking models, including prediction objectives, feature interactions, user-history modeling, and calibration

-
Take end to end ownership of machine learning systems - from data pipelines, feature engineering, training-data construction and model evaluation, model training, as well as integration into our production systems

-
Evaluate and apply advances in deep learning and recommendation modeling to improve ads ranking within production latency, reliability, and cost constraints

-
Collaborate with ML platform and product engineers to build scalable and efficient machine learning systems in the production environment

-
Partner with product, data science, and engineering teams to define ranking objectives, design A/B experiments, and measure improvements in advertiser performance, revenue, and user relevance

-
Identify new opportunities to apply machine learning to different parts of the Ads product to drive value for our users and advertisers

Minimum Requirements:

-
Availability for meetings and impromptu communication during Quora's “coordination hours" (Mon-Fri: 9am-3pm Pacific Time)

-
4+ years of professional software development experience in machine learning

-
Hands-on experience developing and deploying ads ranking models at scale, including CTR or CVR prediction and calibration, with demonstrated ownership of production improvements

-
Experience evaluating ranking models through offline analysis and online experiments, including investigating discrepancies between model metrics and business outcomes

-
Experience using AI-assisted development tools for coding, testing, debugging, or data analysis, with sound judgment in validating generated code and conclusions

-
Hands-on experience building and deploying deep learning models with PyTorch or TensorFlow

-
Good understanding of mathematical foundations of machine learning algorithms

-
Strong Python programming skills and experience writing maintainable production ML code. proficient coding ability writing Python

-
BS, MS or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field

Preferred Requirements:

-
Experience with modern ranking architectures, such as feature interaction networks, attention-based user-sequence models, and multi-task learning

-
Understanding of how ranking predictions and calibration interact with bidding and auctions to affect ad delivery and advertiser outcomes

-
Experience with leading large-scale multi-engineer projects

-
Experience addressing ranking challenges such as sparse or delayed conversion labels, sampling and exposure bias, cold-start users, or training-serving inconsistencies

-
Experience with generative recommender systems

-
Effective communicator with strong leadership skills

-
Passion for Quora's mission and goals

jobs.title: Director, Government Relations
jobs.description:
About Us
Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

The Role

As the Director of Government Relations at Fanatics, you work closely with our leadership team to ensure we remain at the forefront of legislative trends and industry developments. In this role, you will provide strategic insights, advocate for our interests, and drive initiatives that reflect Fanatics' commitment to innovation, consumer satisfaction, and the evolving retail landscape. The Director of Government Relations reports to the SVP, Head of Fanatics Global Government Relations team.

What You’ll Do:

- Forge and Maintain Strategic Relationships: Cultivate and sustain high-impact relationships with key government officials—including Governors, State Attorneys General, and key state and local level policymakers,—to advance Fanatics’ priorities.

- Provide Executive-Level Legislative Intelligence: Keep Fanatics leadership informed with timely, in-depth analyses of current and proposed legislation affecting the retail, sports, sports betting, and e-commerce sectors, ensuring proactive and informed decision-making.

- Shape Policy and Drive Advocacy: Monitor the legislative and regulatory landscape, assess potential business impacts, and develop tailored, forward-thinking strategies that position Fanatics for success.

- Craft Persuasive Policy Communications: Develop compelling policy documents, including executive summaries, position papers, and advocacy briefs, that clearly articulate Fanatics’ policy positions to key stakeholders.

- Lead Cross-Functional Collaboration: Manage external consultants, engage internal stakeholders, and oversee special projects that align with and advance Fanatics’ policy and business objectives.

- Advocate with Authority: Present Fanatics’ policy positions to government officials, trade associations, coalitions, and industry stakeholders, ensuring alignment between corporate priorities and broader legislative and market trends.

- Strengthen Industry Influence: Enhance partnerships with trade associations, advocacy groups, and community organizations, reinforcing Fanatics' role as a thought leader in the retail and sports ecosystem.

- Innovate and Push Boundaries: Develop and execute creative advocacy strategies that challenge the status quo and unlock new opportunities for Fanatics in a rapidly evolving regulatory environment.

- Showcase Fanatics’ Impact: Organize immersive site visits, retail events, and media engagements for elected officials to deepen their understanding of Fanatics’ business model, innovation, and community contributions.

What We’re Looking For:

- Policy Expertise & Thought Leadership: Deep understanding of public policy, with the ability to distill complex regulatory issues into clear, actionable insights.

-  Extensive Experience in and understanding of the Legislative and Regulatory Process is required. 10+ years of state legislative, state executive government, or state government affairs experience in Washington, including meaningful experience including working across the aisle.

- Political Acumen & Agility: Highly adaptable, with the ability to anticipate and respond to shifting political and regulatory landscapes.

- Political Campaign and Electoral Experience highly valued.

- Compelling Communicator: Exceptional writing, presentation, and interpersonal skills to effectively articulate Fanatics' policy positions and influence diverse audiences.

- Master Negotiator & Influencer: Proven ability to navigate complex policy challenges, persuade stakeholders, and drive favorable outcomes.

- Strategic & Innovative Problem Solver: A visionary approach to advocacy, with the ability to develop creative solutions that advance Fanatics' objectives.

- Proven Leadership & Execution: Demonstrated success in leading teams and managing projects from strategy development through execution.

- Self-Starter with a Collaborative Mindset: Highly motivated, able to work independently while fostering cross-functional collaboration to drive impact.

- Storytelling & Brand Amplification: Passion for shaping and elevating the corporate narrative through strategic communications.

jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist - Quora
jobs.description:
[Quora is a privately held, "remote-first" company. This position can be performed remotely from multiple countries around the world. Please visit careers.quora.com/eligible-countries for details regarding employment eligibility by country.]

About Quora:
Quora’s mission is to grow the world's collective intelligence. To do so, we have two platforms:

-
Quora: a global knowledge sharing platform with millions of monthly unique visitors, bringing people together to share insights on various topics and providing a unique platform to learn and connect with others.

-
Poe: a cloud workspace where millions of users run multiple AI agents on shared context and tools. One subscription, every frontier model, and the collaboration layer that makes them work together.

Behind these products are passionate, collaborative, and high-performing global teams. We have a culture rooted in transparency, idea-sharing, and experimentation that allows us to celebrate success and grow together through meaningful work. Join us on this journey to create a positive impact and make a significant change in the world.

This role will be working on our Quora product.

About the Team and Role:
The Data Team is highly empowered at Quora, helping navigate complexity and influencing product and company strategy directly. Quora's outsized commitment to data is visible in everything we do, from our sophisticated experimentation processes to the backgrounds of our leaders. With this emphasis on data and empirics, we aim to balance rigor and pragmatism, searching for scrappy solutions in pursuit of our mission. In joining Quora's strong data team, you'll both benefit from and help advance our culture of rational decision making.

As a member of our team, you'll work closely with product managers, product designers, engineers, and other cross-functional partners to devise appropriate measurements and metrics, design randomized controlled experiments, build visualizations, and tackle hard, open-ended problems that uncover usage patterns and opportunities across Quora. Quora has a wide range of rich data, giving you ample room for exploration and creativity.

Data scientists at Quora work across multiple domains, including user growth, content quality, monetization, personalization, marketplace dynamics, and long-term company strategy. Example projects include modeling long-term growth, improving the relevance and personalization of the homepage feed, analyzing drivers of user engagement and question-asking behavior, optimizing marketplace efficiency, and evaluating the effectiveness of monetization initiatives.

Responsibilities:

-
Own ambiguous, high-impact problem spaces across product and business domains, from question framing, to devising and conducting the analysis, to developing and implementing solutions with cross-functional partners

-
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders and company leadership to shape product strategy and anticipate future challenges

-
Design and evaluate experiments to measure the impact of product and strategic changes

-
Analyze data from across the product to uncover root causes of metric movements

-
Develop tools, methodologies, and frameworks that help make both the data team and the company as a whole smarter about data

-
Multiply the impact of other data scientists through mentorship and instilling industry best practices across the team

Minimum Requirements:

-
Availability for meetings and impromptu communication during Quora's “coordination hours" (Mon-Fri: 9am-3pm Pacific Time)

-
7+ years work experience in an analytical or quantitative role, including 5+ as a Data Scientist or similar title, with a track record of success at a senior or staff level of scope and autonomy

-
Demonstrated ability to tackle difficult data questions that few others could have taken on, such as those requiring deep ownership of a product area and/or leading cross-functional and cross-team efforts

-
Expertise with statistical techniques (e.g. regression, hypothesis testing, causal inference) and their practical application

-
Experience mentoring other data scientists and raising team standards through best practices and process improvements

-
Effective communication skills, including the ability to translate ambiguous business needs into analytical questions and to explain technical results to executives and cross-functional partners

-
Extensive experience using a procedural programming language (e.g. Python, R) for data manipulation, modeling, and analysis; comfort working in a production codebase

-
Strong judgment that blends quantitative rigor with product intuition and common sense

Preferred Requirements:

-
2+ years of experience evaluating recommender systems in offline analysis and online experiments

-
Experience setting technical direction or strategy for a team or major workstream

-
Experience with large data sets and distributed computing tools (e.g. Presto/Trino)

-
Active Quora user with curiosity about the product

At Quora, we value diversity and inclusivity and welcome individuals from all backgrounds, including marginalized or underrepresented groups in tech, to apply for our job openings. We encourage all candidates who share a passion for growing the world’s knowledge, even those who may not strictly meet all the preferred requirements, to apply, as we know that a diverse range of perspectives can have a significant impact on our products and our culture.
