jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Finance Technology
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

URL: https://redditinc.com/

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

About the Role
Reddit is looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the product management of our Finance SaaS portfolio, our systems that run treasury, planning, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, quote-to-cash, payroll, and equity. This is a player-coach role: you'll coach and manage a small team of SaaS product managers who each own a domain of Finance's application stack, while personally owning your own set of applications as a player. This role serves as the orchestration layer for Finance and AI Transformation, requiring you to advise senior executives, influence strategic direction, and navigate complex matrixed environments to translate high-level strategy into measurable business outcomes.

You set the product vision and roadmap across the Finance SaaS landscape, decide what gets built and bought, drive adoption, and own the vendor relationships that underpin the stack. You partner closely with the Enterprise Architecture & Engineering team. They own how systems are built and integrated; you own what we build, why, and when.

You will be at the forefront of our AI-first finance strategy, championing the next generation of intelligent automation to redefine efficiency and scalability across our global operations. If you're energized by translating complex  finance processes into clean, well-run systems, thrive at the seam between business and technology, and want to both lead a team and stay close to the product yourself, this role is for you.

What You'll Do
Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership

- Own the end-to-end product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for Reddit's Finance SaaS portfolio across P2P, R2R, QTC, payroll & equity, and treasury/investments/EPM.
- As the lead for Finance & AI Transformation, you are the catalyst for shifting Reddit’s finance teams from manual processes to AI-enabled workflows. This includes championing a “finance engineer” mindset, proactively identifying AI use cases for close automation and anomaly detection, and fostering a culture where data-driven innovation is embedded in our operating model.
- Translate Finance's priorities (e.g., close acceleration, scalability, public-company rigor, M&A) into a sequenced, defensible roadmap.
- Lead build-vs-buy and vendor selection decisions; serve as the product voice in Finance technology investments alongside the Enterprise Architect.
- Define and enforce a consistent product operating model across the team: intake, prioritization, release management, change management, and adoption measurement.
- Identify opportunities to improve Finance processes through AI-enabled workflows, reconciliations, anomaly detection, approval copilots, and close automation.
- Drive roadmap prioritization using measurable outcomes such as close cycle reduction, automation rates, SOX compliance effectiveness, and Finance productivity improvements.
- Establish a single, transparent demand pipeline so Finance stakeholders can see what's planned, in flight, and shipped.
- Assess the end-to-end finance processes to identify manual workflows, process gaps, control weaknesses, data quality issues, and opportunities to improve and enable AI-powered solutions..
- Create a cross-functional decision framework for Finance capabilities, including clear ownership, intake, prioritization, readiness criteria, and business sign-off.
- Identify, design, and launch new features and system capabilities that enhance user efficiency while driving incremental value for the business.
- Partner with finance leadership to enable AI use across teams, fundamentally shifting the organization toward a "finance engineer" mindset where finance teams are empowered to build, automate, and innovate within our systems.
- Drive end-to-end finance transformation initiatives across Quote-to-Cash (QTC), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), and Hire-to-Retire (H2R), ensuring alignment between process improvements and long-term scalability.

Strategic Orchestration & Influence

- Advise senior Finance and Tech leadership on roadmap trade-offs, balancing speed, risk, and long-term impact.
- Navigate organizational dynamics to secure alignment across Finance, Tech, and Business partners.
- Promote harmony between internal teams and external integration partners by resolving bottlenecks and managing cross-functional dependencies.
- Lead a rigorous diligence program to evaluate and optimize system performance, workflows, and adoption metrics to strengthen operational quality.

Team Leadership

- Directly manage a team of SaaS product managers, each owning a Finance domain (P2P & R2R, QTC, Payroll & Equity).
- Set clear direction and priorities for each domain, and create space for deep, high-quality product work.
- Develop your team's craft through roadmap review, stakeholder coaching, and regular 1:1s focused on growth.
- Serve as an escalation point and thought partner when your PMs hit ambiguity, contention over priorities, or cross-functional friction.
- Build the bench: define the team's coverage model, identify gaps, and grow the function as Finance scales.

Hands-On Product Ownership:

- Maintain direct ownership over a specific set of applications, leading their product roadmaps and managing key stakeholder relationships.
- This isn't a purely managerial role: you'll run intake, prioritize enhancements, manage releases, and partner directly with Finance and the Eng team to deliver in your own portfolio.
- Stay close enough to the work to credibly coach your team and make sharp product tradeoffs.

Vendor and Demand Management

- Own Finance SaaS vendor relationships at the portfolio level: renewals, SLAs, roadmap influence, escalations, and spend rationalization.
- Bring a demand-management mindset to intake; help Finance stakeholders articulate needs, size effort, and sequence work effectively rather than absorbing every request.
- Partner with Procurement and Finance leadership on tooling spend, contract timing, and consolidation opportunities.
- Maintain a clear view of total cost of ownership and license utilization across the stack.

Stakeholder Partnership

- Act as the primary product liaison for Finance leadership, translating business requirements into roadmap decisions and communicating tradeoffs clearly.
- Partner with FP&A, Technical Accounting, Revenue, Treasury, Payroll, and Finance Operations to understand pain points and proactively surface system improvements.
- Work hand-in-glove with the Enterprise Architect and Engineering team to land integrations, data quality, and technical delivery against the product roadmap.
- Support M&A activity (e.g., systems due diligence, gap analysis, integration sequencing, and adoption planning for acquired entities).

What We're Looking For

- 8+ years in product management, business/finance systems, or finance transformation, including 2+ years directly managing people.
- Demonstrated ownership of Finance SaaS platforms across multiple domains (ERP, EPM/CPM, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, treasury, or payroll).
- Track record of building and running a product/intake operating model: roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, release and change management.
- Strong vendor management chops: selection, renewals, SLAs, and influencing vendor roadmaps
- Prior people management experience, with a track record of developing PM or systems-analyst talent.
- Strong ability to operate across abstraction levels: comfortable in an executive roadmap discussion and in the configuration details of a specific platform.
- Excellent communication skills: you can frame a portfolio strategy for a CFO and a sprint priority for an engineer in the same afternoon.
- Strong knowledge of financial controls, audit readiness, SOX requirements, data quality, and compliance impacts.
- Experience defining close transformation roadmaps, reconciliation strategies, reporting readiness plans, and UAT strategies.
- Proven success scaling products and owning business outcomes in high-growth, complex environments.

Bonus Points

- Experience at a high-growth public technology company
- Familiarity with Reddit's existing Finance tech stack (NetSuite, Workato, Adaptive, Zip, Coupa, Ramp, Workday, Salesforce or comparable) or similar environments
- Familiarity with advertising platforms and transformation initiatives spanning quote-to-cash or procure-to-pay workflows
- Experience supporting M&A workstreams (diligence, integration, cutover)
- Exposure to SOX compliance considerations in finance systems
- Background partnering with Corporate Engineering or shared-services models

Why This Role, Why Reddit
Reddit's Finance organization is scaling rapidly through organic growth, internal investments, and increasing public-company rigor. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Finance technology evolves at a consequential moment: owning the product direction for a portfolio that touches every corner of the company, leading a team, and keeping your own hands on the work.

You'll have the autonomy to set direction, the team support to execute, and the organizational access to make product decisions that stick.

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

The base salary range for this position is:

$210,800 - $295,200 USD

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.  We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.  We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.  For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors.

Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Why do you want this new job
jobs.description:
No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â

In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far:

- Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years.- Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance.- Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss.- Iâm looking for more challenging work.

All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills

Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills.

About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer.

If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job.

About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job.

Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it.

In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. As long as you are able to justify why you want the new job, theyâll be quite accommodating.

jobs.description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

- Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security. - Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation. - Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do. - Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."- Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it. - Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

- Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth. - Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook. - An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code. - Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling. - Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you. - Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus. - Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

- You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team. - A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders. - We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it. - Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity. - Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas. - Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. How we work

Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

jobs.title: Mac MSP Help Desk Guru (work from home)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: ignitionit.com

URL: https://ignitionit.com

APPLY HERE: https://go.cultureindex.com/p/bLvP56CvGHU

Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first

TL;DR

ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, capable first voice our clients reach when something isn't working. This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role.

We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you.

What the actual job???

Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.”

You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there.

In a typical week, you might:

-
Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless.

-
Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with.

-
Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing.

-
Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone.

-
Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline."

⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job.

About ignitionit.com

We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile!

What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way.

We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here.

If you need a rigid, fully-documented, never-changes environment where nobody trusts you with admin access, where you will be micro-managed so you never have to wonder whether or not you’re doing the right thing, this isn't it. You’ll have a ton of independence on our team, and freedom to use your best judgment to get the ball over the finish line, but that also means we expect you to be naturally responsible, honest, and highly accountable — to yourself, your teammates, and the clients. As they say, the price of freedom is eternal vigilance.

The tech you'll work with (and grow into)

Day one, you'll be living in:

-
Apple at the core — macOS, iOS, Apple Business Manager, and MDM (Jamf / Iru / Intune / Workspace ONE / and more)

-
Yes, PCs too — about one-third of our users are driving Windows

-
Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 admin consoles

-
Identity and access — SSO, MFA, and security keys (Okta, Entra ID, Yubikey, and friends)

-
Lots of other security tools — our stack is constantly evolving and may vary from client to client

-
The everyday productivity stack — Slack, Zoom, conference-room AV, networking basics (Meraki), and endpoint tooling

⠀ You don't need to know all of this. You need to be the kind of person who wants to. As you grow, there's a clear path into infrastructure administration, project architecture and implementation, and — for the right person — security and compliance work (phishing simulations, endpoint detection, SOC 2 / CIS / SEC readiness, due diligence questionnaire support, etc.). That's where our most senior people live, and it's wide open.

Who we hope you are

The hard requirements — we won't move forward unless you:

-
Can work standard business hours in Eastern or Pacific time zones (we currently need both)

-
Have a quiet home workspace and reliable broadband

-
Have proven Apple aptitude — you actually use and like the Apple ecosystem

-
Have at least 2 years of IT support experience on the job. Go-getters who are just getting started and can prove they have a deep, demonstrable history of teaching themselves technology for the sheer joy of it might also make the cut.

⠀ Everything else — and this is the longer list, on purpose. We figure technical skills are teachable; character takes a lot longer. So we're looking for someone who:

-
Genuinely cares — about clients, teammates, and doing right by people

-
Loves to learn, and proves it in how they spend their time

-
Reads, and writes clearly — clear writing is clear thinking, and you'll do a lot of it

-
Stays calm and kind with a frustrated person on the other end of the line

-
Can tell the difference between good customer service and fantastic customer service, and refuses to settle for the former

-
Notices when something's being done inefficiently and fixes it (you may boast about it later, that’s fine)

-
Proofreads their own work (yes, we noticed whether you proofread your application)

-
Has a sense of humor, and doesn't take themselves too seriously

Regarding AI

Our company founder/CEO is headquartered in the Bay Area. We work with innovative, ambitious companies developing AI products. Our team members hold a range of opinions about whether AI is “good or bad” for humans, but at the end of the day, we embrace the plain fact that it is here, we must embrace it to evolve, and our clients increasingly depend on us to help them embrace it, too, to help them evolve and stay competitive.

Our CEO's opinion: AI will not replace human labor any time soon; rather, AI is a new opportunity to either (a) get things done faster, or (b) get a much higher quality of output than before. If you’re an AI tinkerer, great! We want to hear how you’re using it and see your latest vibe project. If you’re allergic to AI or have no interest in learning new habits to work effectively with it, this is not the place for you.

Compensation & logistics

-
Base salary: For applicants closer to the junior side who are located in the USA, $50,000–$65,000/yr, depending on experience level and your local geographical price index. With experience, comp goes up from there. Genuinely experienced, more senior candidates can be slotted higher — let's talk. Applicants outside the USA will be compensated according to your local employment market.

-
Type & location: Full-time, work from home, fully remote. Eastern or Pacific time zones.

-
Benefits: Medical / dental / vision for the employee, 401(k) with employer contribution, 2 weeks of PTO annually to start, and a stipend for your home internet.

How to apply

The first step is really easy and only takes 10 minutes — no resume, no cover letter, no essays. Here's how:

-
Take this online Culture Index assessment (about 10 minutes): We use it to screen for people whose natural wiring fits how our team works.

-
If your profile lines up with what we're looking for, we'll reach out and ask you to complete a 60-minute TestGorilla assessment for critical thinking skills, send us your resume, and maybe a couple of other items.

-
From there, we conduct between 2-4 video interviews. One of these might be a live technical assessment.

If the Culture Index step feels like a strange way to start a job application — that's kind of the point. Remember the phrase Think Different?

Ignition is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and will consider all qualified applicants. Good luck in your search — and may the Force be with you!

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ignition-inc-mac-msp-help-desk-guru-work-from-home

jobs.title: Data Science Lead
jobs.description:
Pilotly is the first self-service insights platform for media content- we make complex research simple, fast and cost effective. Through our interactive video platform, we are able to collect detailed consumer feedback rapidly from specific target audiences, and then process the data using our A.I. algorithms to surface valuable insights to our clients. We’re in a unique position to completely change the consumer insights landscape affecting culture around the world, because, after all, the most influential communications leverage video. Help us become the platform of records for every organization, small to large, that needs to optimize the outcome of their video.

Every day we’re collecting hundreds of thousands of data points from our research studies. Whether it’s a response to a question, a user interaction with our video experience or an implicit activity we derive insight from, there is always data being collected during a Pilotly experience. While we process this data to surface insights for clients, there is a bigger picture opportunity here. We can look at data across industries to surface market trends, identify new performance indicators that leverage our depth of respondent data and match our 1st party with 3rd party data to produce new valuable insights.

Using your background in math, statistics and computer science, we’re excited for you to turn our millions of consumer data points into a playground of valuable information for our clients.

Overall Expectation
*As Pilotly continues to grow at an accelerating rate, we need someone who can fully digest the breadth of consumer data that we have and arrange it into a symphony of insights that can both improve our product and help customers. You’re to be the one who ensures that none of our data is dormant. *

| A Good Baseline to Start from
-Advanced degree in a quantitative discipline (applied mathematics, statistics, computer science, physics, or other related field) from an academic institution

-Expert in Python and SQL, as well as experience with MongoDb

-Excellent communication skills with demonstrated success presenting complex data and analysis in a clear and compelling manner that inspires action

-Knowledge of advanced statistical techniques used in market research

-Quick learner, with the ability to initiate and drive projects to completion with minimal guidance

-Preferably experienced with dataset from TV data providers like Nielsen and Comscore

| Your Daily Grind
-Support research services with complex data analysis and validation of certain consumer insight assertions

-Apply your expertise in quantitative analysis, data mining, and the presentation of data to see beyond the numbers and understand how users interact with our products

-Keep research norms up to date, using this data to create new and better ways to quickly inform clients of their content’s overall performance

-Mine Pilotly data to extract actionable insights that inform, influence, support, and help execute our product decisions and launches. While mining data you’ll be working to surface new key metrics that tie tightly to content performance, giving us new ways to provide value to our clients

-Design and implement reporting and metrics that track and monitor the performance of our products, the quality of our data, and overall health of the business

| Why Pilotly
-We’re always building new media technology that keeps us ahead of the market

-We are affecting culture, so we must be purveyors of culture, our team reflects that. We pride ourselves on keeping the Pilotly team diverse and versatile in thought

-Every day is a different experience when you work with video, one day you’re talking with the creators of your favorite TV show and the next you’re meeting an influencer that a brand is creating content around

-Stay creative, everyone on our team does. Work with people who don’t just geek on out on technology, we have lives outside of the 60 hour weeks

-Health benefits available

-Oh and unlimited paid time off

The Director, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) will support with strategic oversight to direct, manage, and improve the revenue cycle operations that favorably impact accounts receivable, cash acceleration, and net revenue. The Director, RCM will be responsible for defining ways to leverage data for management decision making, performance monitoring, or future planning. Lead Crypto Risk Readiness- Design risk policies, surveillance models, drawdown rules, and operational guardrails for the Crypto programme launching. Crypto carries different volatility, exposure, and abuse patterns than CFD or Futures — your work here defines whether we launch safely.

Hunt Fraud and Abuse- Strengthen detection and response to multi-account abuse, identity fraud, and toxic trading patterns. Partner with Engineering, Data, Compliance, and Customer Operations to build a defensible, scalable abuse-prevention capability.

Partner Across the Firm- Be the trusted risk voice in product design, dealing operations, engineering, compliance, and analytics. - You have led risk policy design for a new asset class launch — ideally Crypto.

JOB PURPOSEThe Senior Building Physicist will lead and deliver advanced building performance and urban physics assessments across building and master planning projects. The role covers daylight and glare, thermal comfort, microclimate and wind comfort, solar radiation, energy performance, building envelope optimisation, passive design, climate resilience and decarbonisation. The role will translate simulation results into practical, design-led recommendations and optimisation strategies; establish robust modelling methodologies and workflows; ensure technical quality and consistency of deliverables; and support multidisciplinary project delivery and client engagement.

QUALIFICATION / EXPERIENCE
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in building physics, Architectural Engineering, Mechanical , Civil Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or a related discipline.

- Minimum 4–7 years of relevant professional experience in building physics, building performance simulation, environmental design, energy modelling, microclimate analysis, or sustainability consulting, preferably within multidisciplinary design or engineering consultancy.

- Proven practical experience with building performance and environmental simulation tools, supported by strong knowledge of relevant international and regional standards, codes and sustainability frameworks.

- Experience in energy auditing and operational building performance analysis is desirable, including the ability to interpret measured data and identify energy conservation and optimisation opportunities.

- Advanced proficiency in environmental analysis tools such as IES, Rhino/Grasshopper, Ladybug/Honeybee, ClimateStudio, ENVI met and/or CFD platforms.

- Demonstrated experience delivering daylight, glare, thermal comfort, solar radiation, wind/microclimate and building envelope optimisation studies for buildings and/or masterplans.

- Experience working with architects, landscape architects, MEP engineers and sustainability teams to influence design decisions through performance-based analysis.

- Professional accreditation such as LEED AP, WELL AP, Estidama PQP, CIBSE, ASHRAE or equivalent is advantageous.

SKILLS / EXPERTISE REQUIRED
- Building performance simulation: advanced understanding of heat transfer, solar gains, internal loads, HVAC interactions, thermal comfort and whole-building energy performance.

- Daylight and glare analysis: ability to undertake and interpret daylight availability, daylight autonomy, glare and visual comfort assessments and translate results into façade and space-planning recommendations.

- Microclimate and urban physics: strong capability in solar radiation, outdoor thermal comfort, pedestrian wind comfort, shading and climate-responsive masterplanning assessments.

- Building envelope and passive design: expertise in façade performance, glazing selection, shading optimisation, orientation, massing, natural ventilation and other passive design strategies.

- Modelling tools and workflows: strong hands-on capability with IES-VE; strong hands-on knowledge of Rhino/Grasshopper, Ladybug/Honeybee and ClimateStudio; experience with CFD tools such as OpenFOAM or equivalent. Ability to develop parametric and comparative modelling workflows is highly desirable.

- Energy and decarbonisation: ability to develop energy conservation measures, compare design options, assess renewable energy opportunities and support operational energy and decarbonisation strategies.

- Standards and compliance: strong working knowledge of ASHRAE and CIBSE guidance and relevant regional codes; familiarity with LEED, WELL, BREEAM, Estidama/PBRS, Mostadam/PCRS and Saudi Building Code requirements relevant to building physics.

- Technical QA/QC: ability to define modelling assumptions and methodologies, review models and calculations, challenge inputs and results, troubleshoot modelling issues, and ensure outputs are technically defensible and fit for purpose.

- Data analysis and technical reporting: ability to analyse large simulation datasets, identify performance drivers and clearly communicate findings through concise reports, dashboards, graphics and presentations.

- Design advisory and communication: ability to convert complex simulation results into practical design recommendations and communicate effectively with clients, architects, engineers and non-specialist stakeholders.

- Project and team leadership: ability to plan technical workstreams, manage priorities and deadlines, review deliverables, mentor team members and coordinate multidisciplinary inputs.

- Commercial awareness: understanding of scope, programme, fee utilisation and change management, with the ability to support proposals, technical scopes and client presentations.

GENERAL EXPECTANCY
- Demonstrates advanced technical expertise and sound professional judgement across core building physics disciplines.

- Provides proactive technical leadership, design insight and evidence-based recommendations that improve project outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIESCore Role
- Lead urban physics and environmental performance assessments across building and master planning projects, providing technical direction across daylight, glare, thermal comfort, microclimate, energy, passive design, climate resilience, and decarbonisation.

- Translate simulation outputs and technical analysis into practical, design-led recommendations, performance targets, and optimisation strategies for architects, engineers, developers, and clients.

- Establish project methodologies, modelling approaches, assessment criteria, and workflows, while ensuring the quality and technical robustness of project deliverables.

- Collaborate and coordinate with architects, engineers, and sustainability consultants to integrate building physics principles into design solutions.

Technical Responsibilities
- Lead and undertake advanced assessments covering daylight, glare, thermal comfort, microclimate, wind comfort, solar radiation, energy performance, building envelope optimisation, passive design and renewable energy.

- Develop and optimise building and masterplan strategies, including orientation, massing, façade design, glazing, shading, landscape and other passive measures.

- Develop and manage simulation workflows using tools such as IES-VE, Rhino/Grasshopper, Honeybee/Ladybug, ClimateStudio, OpenFOAM and CFD workflows, including parametric and comparative studies where required.

Standards & Compliance
- Interpret and apply relevant international and regional standards, codes, and sustainability frameworks, including LEED, WELL, Mostadam/PCRS, Estidama PBRS, Saudi Building Code, ASHRAE, CIBSE, and NEN 8100.

- Establish appropriate and defensible methodologies for demonstrating compliance, particularly where project requirements are ambiguous or require interpretation, and advise project teams on performance targets and compliance strategies.

- Contribute to sustainability certifications (e.g., LEED, BREEAM, Estidama, WELL, Mostadam) where applicable.

- Stay updated with evolving codes, standards, and best practices in building physics, energy performance, and environmental design.

Project & Client Responsibilities
- Lead technical discussions with clients and multidisciplinary teams, communicating complex building physics concepts and simulation findings in a clear and design-oriented manner.

- Coordinate with architecture, landscape, MEP and other disciplines to integrate environmental performance considerations into design development, while managing technical deliverables, programme requirements and project priorities.

Team Leadership

Business Development & Service Development

COMPETENCIES

- Client Focus / Relationship Building - Maintain and strengthen high levels of Client satisfaction and feedback. Preparation of proposals and seeking and winning new work.

DEMONSTRATED KNOWLEDGE BASE AND PROFESSIONAL SKILLSET

- Time Management / Planning - Plans and manages technical workstreams and projects, including programmes, budgets, resources, dependencies, quality requirements and delivery risks.

- Industry Experience / Thought Leadership - Demonstrated expertise in discipline, industry leadership through participation in industry professional groups and conferences and the development of research publications.

Resolves complex project issues and contributes to improving cross-functional delivery processes and efficiency.

- Leadership / Team Management Experience - Ability to independently manage project delivery, allocate and review technical tasks, and mentor junior and intermediate team members and graduates.

- Commercial Acumen / Business Development - Understands project budgets, fee utilisation, scope management and commercial risks. Supports proposals, fee estimates, scope development and client relationships, contributing to the commercial success and growth of the service line.

- Upholding AESG Core Values - Upholds AESG Core Values, including Honesty, Flexibility, Adaptability, Client-centricity and Collaboration.

What the Regulatory Affairs department does at the Worldwide

Regulatory Affairs plays a pivotal role in navigating the complex regulatory landscape, ensuring the success of diverse clinical trials. As subject matter experts, the team leads submissions to regulatory authorities, coordinates with ethics committees across EMEA, Asia Pacific, and Latin America, and ensures compliance with evolving regulations. Their expertise drives the development and approval of innovative medical products, supports business development efforts, and offers strategic guidance on contract negotiations. They also mentor junior staff, review key documentation for global regulatory standards, and keep all stakeholders informed throughout the submission process

What you will do
- Review study budgets and costing about contract negotiation, participate in business development activities, prepare regulatory sections of proposals and feasibility reports and attend bid defense meetings to meet business needs
- Coordinate & manage regulatory & ethics committee submissions and maintain approvals throughout EMEA, Asia Pacific and Latin America regions and ensure accurate compilation, management and tracking of submissions
- Provide expert regulatory advice and contribute to regulatory project work. Effectively communicate status of submissions with the Sponsor, Project Manager, CRAs, and Medical & Scientific Affairs staff. Contribute towards the preparation of technical documentation such as IMPDs and IBs, review and make recommendations on all relevant documentation to ensure compliance with ICH GCP & country-specific requirements
- Provide training, coaching, and mentoring to junior members of staff, may be required to line manage junior members of staff

What you will bring to the role
- Clearly, proven leadership and organizational management skills are essential attributes
- Strong planning, strategizing, managing, monitoring, scheduling, and critiquing skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills to clearly and concisely present information
- Relationship-building competency combined with demonstrated comfort supporting Business Development at a face-to-face meeting
- Strong interpersonal skills in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented, and changing environment
- Excellent ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced and constantly changing environment

Your experience
- A minimum four-year college curriculum with a major concentration in medical, biological, physical, health, pharmacy or other related science, OR…
- Two-year college curriculum or equivalent education/training (nursing degree or equivalent life science degree) and eight years of experience within clinical research (e.g., CRA, Reg Affairs)
- Minimum 5-7 years within the pharmaceutical/CRO industry, with demonstrated senior-level regulatory or clinical start-up experience
- Proficient in cross-cultural communication and proficient in both spoken and written English

jobs.title: Contracts Administrator (PRN - Approx 5 hours per week)
jobs.description:
Alcanza is a growing multi-site, multi-phase clinical research company with a network of locations in AL, AZ, FL, GA, IL, MA, MI, MO, NV, VA, SC, TN, TX and Puerto Rico. We have established a strong presence across Phase I-IV studies and several therapeutic areas including vaccine, neurology, dermatology, psychiatry, and general medicine. Join us as we continue to grow.

The Contracts Administrator is responsible for drafting various contractor and employment agreements and amendments. This role partners closely with HR and executive leadership to ensure contractual terms align with business objectives while minimizing legal and financial risks.Key Responsibilities
Essential Job Duties:

- Support the administration, maintenance, and consistent application of 1099 and W2 contracts.
- Draft NDAs, confidentiality, contractor, employment, consulting, and other agreements and amendments, as needed.
- Provide guidance and interpretation of contractual terms, obligations, and compliance requirements.
- Maintenance of a comprehensive contract baseline and record system.
- Maintain a positive, results-oriented work environment and build partnerships within the team and across the organization.
- Handle compensation information with discretion, confidentiality, accuracy, and sound judgment.
- Perform all other duties that may be requested or assigned.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
Minimum Qualifications: A bachelor’s degree in business management, law, or related field, and 2+ years of related contracting experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience is required. Must have strong knowledge of federal and state employment laws and contract terminology.

Required Skills:

- Proficiency with computer applications such as Microsoft applications (Word, Excel, PP, Teams, Sharepoint), web applications, and the ability to type proficiently (40+ wpm)
- Strong organizational, attention to detail, time management, problem-solving, and project coordination skills, with the ability to meet deadlines.
- Well-developed written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and handle highly sensitive compensation and employee information with discretion and professionalism.
- Must possess a high degree of professionalism, integrity, dependability, respect for others, self-motivation, and a strong work ethic.
- Ability to work under minimal supervision, identify problems and implement solutions.
- Ability to handle highly sensitive information in a confidential and professional manner, and in compliance with privacy and company guidelines.

Benefits
- Full-time employees regularly scheduled to work at least 30 hours per week are benefits-eligible, with coverage starting on the first day of the month following date of hire.
- Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short and long-term disability insurance, health savings accounts, supplemental insurances, and a 401k plan with a safe harbor match are offered.
